678-3967-4022.notablePrerequisites: A permanent you control has left the battlefield this turn
678-3967-4022.description:
Cast Hidden Herbalists by paying its mana cost.
When Hidden Herbalists enters, it triggers, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Hidden Herbalists.
When Hidden Herbalists dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Hidden Herbalists from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.

339-677-4460-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
339-677-4460-7272.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1829-2527-4076-4279-4549.easyPrerequisites:
You control another nontoken Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard or Orc that has toughness 2 or more.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1829-2527-4076-4279-4549.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Burakos, adding one mana of any color.
Burakos triggers, causing it and other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the other Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard or Orc, targeting Burakos
When the creature dies, the creature's undying ability and Vindictive Vampire trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Burakos and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing Burakos, targeting the other creature.
When Burakos dies, its undying ability and Vindictive Vampire trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning Burakos from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the other creature and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

512-4644-7704.easyPrerequisites: Doc Samson and Tidewater Minion do not have summoning sickness.
512-4644-7704.description:
Activate Doc Samson by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Tidewater Minion and Doc Samson, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Tidewater Minion ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-4644-7704.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Doc Samson's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

4067-8192.easyPrerequisites:
Niv-Mizzet doesn't have summoning sickness.
Your library isn't empty.
4067-8192.description:
Activate Niv-Mizzet by tapping it, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to pay 1 life to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Niv-Mizzet.
Repeat.

1981-2415-3025-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing it to become a Spirit artifact creature in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

3197-4153-5147--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 5.

277-1308-2557-4772-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1849-2034-6970-7763-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

907-1558-2638-4231-7810.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
907-1558-2638-4231-7810.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Tippy-Toe.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1267-5163-7712.manaNeeded: {1}{U} the first turn with {2} each extra turn
1267-5163-7712.description:
Deal combat damage using Medomai, triggering its ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast The Wondrous Wasp by paying {1}{U}.
When The Wondrous Wasp enters, it triggers, tapping Medomai and causing it to lose all its abilities until The Wondrous Wasp leaves the battlefield.
Move to your next turn.
Declare Medomai as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Roon of the Hidden Realm by paying {2} and tapping it, exiling The Wondrous Wasp until your end step. This will also cause Medomai to regain its abilities.
Deal combat damage using Medomai, triggering its ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Roon of the Hidden Realm triggers, returning The Wondrous Wasp from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

206-3490-6723-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
206-3490-6723-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

339-677-997-7297.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

907-1399-1606-7223.description:
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Selesnya Sanctuary.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

2150-2281-5256.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Hero of the Dunes
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hero of the Dunes
When Hero of the Dunes dies, Saffi triggers, returning Hero of the Dunes from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Hero of the Dunes enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

967-3809-4365-5256-7087.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness and that has power 1 or greater

262-3263-4853-5231.description:
Activate the creature with Elemental Mastery attached by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste equal to its power.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing an Elemental.
When the Elemental dies as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping the creature with Elemental Mastery attached.
Repeat.

225-539-3177-5621.description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.

3188-3197-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3188-3197-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1052-6553-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

2534-3817-5256-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Coercive Recruiter, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Coercive Recruiter from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
When Coercive Recruiter enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Repeat.

457-1753-5159-5491.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of Worldwalker Helm that is a 4/4 Construct artifact creature with haste named Mishra's Warform, and a Map token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping a Map, adding {U}.
Activate Mishra's Warform by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it and a Map token for each Mishra's Warform and/or Worldwalker Helm you control.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping two Maps, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.
457-1753-5159-5491.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

2018-5263-5330.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Atog by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero with a flying counter on it.
Resolve both Atog abilities from steps 1 and 3, giving it +4/+4 until end of turn.
Repeat.

780-2992-4050.description:
Cast Supernatural Stamina by paying {B}, targeting Living Lightning.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Living Lightning, adding {B}.
When Living Lightning dies, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Supernatural Stamina from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

628-2034-2080-2239-3944.notablePrerequisites:
Blood Pet does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
You control another nontoken non-Human creature that does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-2034-2080-2239-3944.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Ardent Elementalist and another nontoken non-Human creature, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the non-Human creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Mikaeus and the non-Human creature, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Rise of the Dark Realms by paying {7}{B}{B}, putting all creature cards from all graveyards onto the battlefield under your control.
When Ardent Elementalist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Living Death to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

372-1621-5144.manaNeeded: {4}{W}{W} plus enough mana to pay for command tax, if applicable
372-1621-5144.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and command tax, if applicable.
Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, exiling Wispweaver Angel and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Wispweaver Angel to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Wispweaver Angel's enters-the-battlefield ability.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Wispweaver Angel and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Wispweaver Angel trigger, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.

3129-3649-3851-4600-4772.notablePrerequisites:
Blade of Selves attached to Etrata.
Etrata does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent owns at least two cards in exile with hit counters on them.
Each opponent controls at least three nontoken creatures, minus one for each card they own in exile with a hit counter on it.
3129-3649-3851-4600-4772.description:
Declare Etrata as an attacker, attacking an opponent that owns at least two cards in exile with hit counters on them.
Etrata's myriad ability triggers, creating four copies of it attacking each other opponent.
Deal combat damage with each Etrata, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the first Etrata ability, causing the opponent dealt damage by it to exile a creature they control with a hit counter on it, and lose the game if they have at least three cards in exile with hit counters on them.
Repeat step 4  for each remaining trigger.

1339-2034-3384-5185.description:
Activate Tymora's Invoker by paying {8}, causing you to draw four cards.
The Locust God triggers four times, creating a total of four 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing the Insects, adding eight {C}.
Repeat.

2232-2452-2782.notablePrerequisites:
At least one creature has died this turn.
You have enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable.
2232-2452-2782.description:
Cast Nevinyrral either from your hand or the command zone by paying {0} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Nevinyrral enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Nevinyrral trigger, creating a tapped 2/2 Zombie creature token for each creature that has died this turn.
Each Zombie enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio that many times.
Resolve the first Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Nevinyrral to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve each remaining Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

776-1329-2709-5281.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Orcish Mechanics do not have summoning sickness.
776-1329-2709-5281.description:
Tap Orcish Mechanics, sacrificing Herbal Poultice to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Herbal Poultice.
Cast Herbal Poultice.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

193-1090-4344.description:
Activate Animatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Lumbering Battlement.
Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, causing Restoration Angel to return to the battlefield.
Restoration Angel and Lumbering Battlement enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Lumbering Battlement trigger, exiling Restoration Angel until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Restoration Angel trigger, blinking Lumbering Battlement.
Repeat from step 2.

579-1247-2033.notablePrerequisites: Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
579-1247-2033.description:
Activate Pili-Pala using Paradise Mantle's ability by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Pili-Pala's other ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding two mana of any one color.
Repeat.
